point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,800 (levels 1-15). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Rain of Arrows T3. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Hollow Point. Ultimate (Guided Owl) is available from Hollow Point.

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Hollow Point completes 5,600 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Hollow Point completes 4.8k weapon in 5600 souls (~5.6 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 11200 souls (~11.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Swift Striker
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Hollow Point completes 3,200 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Hollow Point completes 4.8k weapon in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Hollow Point
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (2,400 to 5,600 invested): bonus 15 to 46% weapon damage.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 10 to Charged Shot's damage (1.00x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Quicksilver Reload
items.caption: Imbued on Rain of Arrows: the imbue charges up over 18s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 10% fire rate for 12s.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,800-20,800 (levels 15-26). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Guided Owl T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Charged Shot, damage) grows from 127 to 164. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Stamina Mastery, spirit 4.8k at Surge of Power.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Stamina Mastery completes 2,400 souls on. Upgrade of Sprint Boots (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Stamina Mastery completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Extra Stamina (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Long Range
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 5,600 to 7,200 invested: bonus 46 to 54% weapon damage.

items.name: Sharpshooter
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 7,200 to 8,000 invested: bonus 54 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Surge of Power
items.why: contradiction: Rain of Arrows has no spirit-scaled effect at any tier, so the imbued spirit has nothing to raise there (the item's move-speed and fire-rate part still works).

items.name: Bullet Lifesteal
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 8,000 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 20,800-51,200 (levels 26-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Charged Shot T3, Spirit Snare T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Charged Shot, damage) grows from 164 to 376.

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: component_for)

items.name: Burst Fire
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 8,800 to 11,200 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.caption: Imbued on Rain of Arrows: the imbue charges up over 14s; the charged use reloads the clip and gives 22% fire rate for 12s. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 9,600 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 52 spirit power. Upgrade of Quicksilver Reload (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Lucky Shot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 11,200 to 17,600 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

items.name: Vampiric Burst
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Pop it in the air during Rain of Arrows.

items.name: Ricochet
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 24,000 to 30,400 invested: bonus 100 to 115% weapon damage.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Stamina Mastery? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Swift Striker.
sections.desc: Dying after Stamina Mastery? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Swift Striker.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Charged Shot (channelled) and Rain of Arrows (movement). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: You keep getting stunned during Rain of Arrows.

items.name: Glass Cannon
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: Sell Swift Striker for this, or Burst Fire if it's gone.

items.name: Crippling Headshot
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..
